notes: NODE-RPI4-01 core turns accepted perception events into tasks (origin context_rule). Raw media never reaches core; only perception attributes.
A rule fires only on the listed transition, and core does not repeat the same intent of one group twice in a row.

feedback_overrides (rules_version 2): a UI feedback (pfn/v1/ui/feedback) with feedback_type and rating as listed, received while the group's last intent is active_intent, makes core send intent at once (origin context_rule, rule = override name) and ignore the group's rules until suppress_until_rule fires (that context ended) or max_suppress_seconds pass. Context and action feedback stay separate rows in feedback_events.
